Saari ta'reef us Allah ke liye hai jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko paida kiya hai aur taareekiyon aur noor ko muqarrar kiya hai, us ke baad bhi kufr ikhtiyaar karne waale doosron ko us ke baraabar qaraar dete hain
Woh Khuda woh hai jis ne tum ko mitti se paida kiya hai, phir ek muddat ka faisla kiya hai, aur ek muqarrara muddat us ke paas aur bhi hai, lekin us ke baad bhi tum shak karte ho
Woh aasmaanon aur zameen har jagah ka Khuda hai, woh tumhaare baatin aur zaahir aur jo tum kaarobaar karte ho sab ko jaanta hai
Un logon ke paas un ke Parwardigar ki koi nishaani nahin aati magar yeh ke yeh us se kinaara-kashi ikhtiyaar kar lete hain
Un logon ne is se pehle bhi haq ke aane ke baad haq ka inkaar kiya hai. Anqareeb un ke paas jin cheezon ka mazaaq udaate the un ki khabrein aane waali hain

Kya unhon ne nahin dekha ke hum ne un se pehle kitni naslon ko tabaah kar diya hai jinhein tum se ziyaada zameen mein iqtidaar diya tha aur un par moosla-dhaar paani bhi barsaaya tha, un ke qadmon mein nahrein bhi jaari thin, phir un ke gunaahon ki bina par inhein halaak kar diya aur un ke baad doosri nasl jaari kar di
Aur agar hum aap par kaaghaz par likhi hui kitaab bhi naazil kar dete aur yeh apne haath se chhoo bhi lete to bhi un ke kaafir yahi kehte ke yeh khula hua jaadu hai
Aur yeh kehte hain ke un par farishta kyon nahin naazil hota, haalaanke hum farishta naazil kar dete to kaam ka faisla ho jaata aur phir inhein kisi tarah ki mohlat na di jaati
Agar hum paighambar ko farishta bhi banaate to bhi mard hi banaate aur wahi libaas pehnaate jo mard pehna karte hain
Paighambar! Aap se pehle bahut se rasoolon ka mazaaq udaaya gaya hai, jis ke nateeje mein mazaaq udaane waalon ke liye un ka mazaaq hi un ke gale pad gaya aur woh us mein ghir gaye
Aap un se keh dijiye ke zameen mein sair karein, phir us ke baad dekhein ke jhutlaane waalon ka anjaam kya hota hai

Un se kahiye ke zameen o aasmaan mein jo kuch bhi hai woh sab kis ke liye hai? Phir bataaiye ke sab Allah hi ke liye hai. Us ne apne oopar rehmat ko laazim qaraar de liya hai, woh tum sab ko qiyaamat ke din ikattha karega jis mein kisi shak ki gunjaaish nahin hai. Jin logon ne apne nafs ko khasaare mein daal diya hai woh ab imaan na laayenge
Aur us Khuda ke liye woh tamaam cheezein hain jo raat aur din mein saabit hain, aur woh sab ki sunne waala aur sab ka jaanne waala hai

Aap kahiye ke kya main Khuda ke ilaawa kisi aur ko apna waali bana loon, jab ke zameen o aasmaan ka paida karne waala wahi hai aur wahi sab ko khilaata hai, us ko koi nahin khilaata hai? Kahiye ke mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main sab se pehla itaa'at-guzaar banoon, aur khabardaar tum log mushrik na ho jaana
Kahiye ke main apne Khuda ki naafarmaani karoon to mujhe bade sangeen din ke azaab ka khatra hai
Us din jis se azaab taal diya jaaye us par Khuda ne bada reham kiya, aur yeh ek khuli hui kaamyaabi hai
Agar Khuda ki taraf se tum ko koi nuqsaan pahunch jaaye to us ke ilaawa koi taalne waala bhi nahin hai, aur agar woh khair de de to wahi har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
Aur apne tamaam bandon par ghaalib aur saahib-e-hikmat aur baakhabar rehne waala hai

Aap keh dijiye ke gawaahi ke liye sab se badi cheez kya hai? Aur bata dijiye ke Khuda hamaare aur tumhaare darmiyaan gawaah hai, aur meri taraf is Quran ki wahi ki gayi hai taake is ke zariye main tumhein aur jahaan tak yeh paighaam pahunche sab ko daraaoon. Kya tum log gawaahi dete ho ke Khuda ke saath koi aur khuda bhi hai? To aap keh dijiye ke main is ki gawaahi nahin de sakta, aur bata dijiye ke Khuda sirf Khuda-e-Waahid hai aur main tumhaare shirk se bezaar hoon

Jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai woh Paighambar ko isi tarah pehchaante hain jis tarah apni aulaad ko pehchaante hain, lekin jin logon ne apne nafs ko khasaare mein daal diya hai woh imaan nahin la sakte
Us se ziyaada zaalim kaun ho sakta hai jo Khuda par bohtaan baandhe aur us ki aayaat ki takzeeb kare? Yaqeenan in zaalimeen ke liye najaat nahin hai
Qiyaamat ke din hum sab ko ek saath uthaayenge, phir mushrikeen se kahenge ke tumhaare woh shurakaa kahaan hain jo tumhaare khayaal mein Khuda ke shareek the
Us ke baad un ka koi fitna na hoga siwaaye is ke ke yeh keh dein ke Khuda ki qasam hum mushrik nahin the
Dekhiye unhon ne kis tarah apne aap ko jhutlaaya aur kis tarah un ka iftira haqeeqat se door nikla

Aur un mein se ba'z log kaan laga kar aap ki baat sunte hain, lekin hum ne un ke dilon par parde daal diye hain, yeh samajh nahin sakte hain, aur un ke kaanon mein bhi behra-pan hai. Yeh agar tamaam nishaaniyon ko dekh lein to bhi imaan na laayenge, yahaan tak ke jab aap ke paas aayenge to bhi behs karenge, aur kuffaar kahenge ke yeh Quran to sirf agle logon ki kahaani hai
Yeh log doosron ko Quran se rokte hain aur khud bhi door bhaagte hain, haalaanke yeh apne hi ko halaak kar rahe hain aur inhein sha'oor tak nahin hai
Agar aap dekhte ke yeh kis tarah Jahannam ke saamne khade kiye gaye aur kehne lage ke kaash hum palta diye jaate aur Parwardigar ki nishaaniyon ki takzeeb na karte aur momineen mein shaamil ho jaate
Balke un ke liye woh sab waazeh ho gaya jise pehle se chhupa rahe the, aur agar yeh palta bhi diye jaayein to wahi karenge jis se yeh roke gaye hain, aur yeh sab jhoote hain
Aur yeh kehte hain ke yeh sirf zindagaani-e-duniya hai aur hum dobaara nahin uthaaye jaayenge

Aur agar aap us waqt dekhte jab inhein Parwardigar ke saamne khada kiya jaaega aur un se khitaab hoga ke kya yeh sab haq nahin hai? To woh log kahenge ke beshak, hamaare Parwardigar ki qasam yeh sab haq hai. To irshaad hoga ke ab apne kufr ke azaab ka maza chakho

Beshak woh log khasaare mein hain jinhon ne Allah ki mulaaqaat ka inkaar kiya, yahaan tak ke jab achaanak qiyaamat aa gayi to kehne lage ke haaye afsos! Hum ne qiyaamat ke baare mein bahut kotaahi ki hai. Us waqt woh apne gunaahon ka bojh apni pusht par laade honge, aur yeh badtareen bojh hoga
Aur yeh zindagaani-e-duniya sirf khel tamaasha hai, aur daar-e-aakhirat saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye sab se behtar hai. Kya tumhaari samajh mein yeh baat nahin aa rahi hai
Humein maaloom hai ke aap ko un ke aqwaal se dukh hota hai, lekin yeh aap ki takzeeb nahin kar rahe hain balke yeh zaalimeen aayaat-e-Ilaahi ka inkaar kar rahe hain

Aur aap se pehle waale rasoolon ko bhi jhutlaaya gaya hai to unhon ne us takzeeb aur aziyyat par sabr kiya hai yahaan tak ke hamaari madad aa gayi, aur Allah ki baaton ka koi badalne waala nahin hai, aur aap ke paas to mursaleen ki khabrein aa chuki hain

Aur agar un ka e'raaz o inhiraaf aap par giraan guzarta hai to agar aap ke bas mein hai ke zameen mein surang bana dein ya aasmaan mein seedhi laga kar koi nishaani le aayein to le aayein. Beshak agar Khuda chaahta to jabran sab ko hidaayat par jama hi kar deta, lihaaza aap apna shumaar naawaaqif logon mein na hone dein
Bas baat ko wahi log qubool karte hain jo sunte hain, aur murdon ko to Khuda hi uthaaega aur phir us ki baargaah mein paltaaye jaayenge
Aur yeh kehte hain ke un ke oopar koi nishaani kyon nahin naazil hoti? To keh dijiye ke Khuda tumhaari pasandeeda nishaani bhi naazil kar sakta hai, lekin aksariyat is baat ko bhi nahin jaanti hai

Aur zameen mein koi bhi rengne waala ya donon paron se parwaaz karne waala taair aisa nahin hai jo apni jagah par tumhaari tarah ki jamaa'at na rakhta ho. Hum ne kitaab mein kisi shai ke bayaan mein koi kami nahin ki hai, us ke baad sab apne Parwardigar ki baargaah mein pesh honge

Aur jin logon ne hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb ki woh behre goonge taareekiyon mein pade hue hain, aur Khuda jise chaahta hai yunhi gumraahi mein rakhta hai aur jise chaahta hai siraat-e-mustaqeem par laga deta hai
Aap un se kahiye ke tumhaara kya khayaal hai ke agar tumhaare paas azaab ya qiyaamat aa jaaye to kya tum apne da'we ki sadaaqat mein ghair-e-Khuda ko bulaaoge
Nahin, tum Khuda hi ko pukaaroge, aur wahi agar chaahega to us museebat ko rafa' kar sakta hai, aur tum apne mushrikaana khudaaon ko bhool jaaoge
Hum ne tum se pehle waali ummaton ki taraf bhi rasool bheje hain, us ke baad inhein sakhti aur takleef mein mubtala kiya ke shaayad hum se gidgidaayein
Phir un sakhtiyon ke baad unhon ne kyon faryaad nahin ki? Baat yeh hai ke un ke dil sakht ho gaye hain aur Shaitaan ne un ke aamaal ko un ke liye aaraasta kar diya hai

Phir jab un naseehaton ko bhool gaye jo inhein yaad dilaayi gayi thin to hum ne imtehaan ke taur par un ke liye har cheez ke darwaaze khol diye, yahaan tak ke jab woh un ne'maton se khush-haal ho gaye to hum ne achaanak inhein apni giraft mein le liya aur woh maayoos ho kar reh gaye
Phir zaalimeen ka silsila munqata' kar diya gaya, aur saari ta'reef us Khuda ke liye hai jo Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai

Aap un se poochhiye ke agar Khuda ne un ki samaa'at o basaarat ko le liya aur un ke dil par mohr laga di to Khuda ke ilaawa doosra kaun hai jo dobaara inhein yeh ne'matein de sakega? Dekho hum apni nishaaniyon ko kis tarah ulat palat kar dikhlaate hain aur phir bhi yeh munh mod lete hain
Aap un se kahiye ke kya tumhaara khayaal hai ke agar achaanak ya ala-l-e'laan azaab aa jaaye to kya zaalimeen ke ilaawa koi aur halaak kiya jaaega
Aur hum to mursaleen ko sirf bashaarat dene waala aur daraane waala bana kar bhejte hain, us ke baad jo imaan le aaye aur apni islaah kar le us ke liye na khauf hai aur na huzn
Aur jin logon ne takzeeb ki inhein un ki naafarmaaniyon ki wajah se azaab apni lapet mein le lega

Aap kahiye ke hamaara da'wa yeh nahin hai ke hamaare paas Khudaai khazaane hain ya hum aalim-ul-ghaib hain, aur na hum yeh kehte hain ke hum farishta hain. Hum to sirf wahi-e-Parwardigar ka ittibaa' karte hain. Aur poochhiye ke kya andhe aur beena baraabar ho sakte hain? Aakhir tum kyon nahin sochte ho

Aur aap is kitaab ke zariye inhein daraayein jinhein yeh khauf hai ke Khuda ki baargaah mein haazir honge aur us ke ilaawa koi sifaarish karne waala ya madadgaar na hoga, shaayad un mein khauf-e-Khuda paida ho jaaye

Aur khabardaar jo log subh o shaam apne Khuda ko pukaarte hain aur Khuda hi ko maqsood banaaye hue hain inhein apni bazm se alag na kijiyega. Na aap ke zimme un ka hisaab hai aur na un ke zimme aap ka hisaab hai, ke aap inhein dhutkaar dein aur is tarah zaalimon mein shumaar ho jaayein

Aur isi tarah hum ne ba'z ko ba'z ke zariye aazmaaya hai taake woh yeh kahein ke yahi log hain jin par Khuda ne hamaare darmiyaan fazl o karam kiya hai? Aur kya woh apne shukr-guzaar bandon ko bhi nahin jaanta

Aur jab aap ke paas woh log aayein jo hamaari aayaton par imaan rakhte hain to un se kahiye Assalaamu Alaikum. Tumhaare Parwardigar ne apne oopar rehmat laazim qaraar de li hai, ke tum mein jo bhi az-roo-e-jahaalat buraai karega aur us ke baad tauba kar ke apni islaah kar lega to Khuda bahut ziyaada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai
Aur hum isi tarah apni nishaaniyon ko tafseel ke saath bayaan karte hain taake mujrimeen ka raasta un par waazeh ho jaaye

Aap keh dijiye ke mujhe is baat se roka gaya hai ke main un ki ibaadat karoon jinhein tum Khuda ko chhod kar pukaarte ho. Keh dijiye ke main tumhaari khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' nahin kar sakta ke is tarah gumraah ho jaaoonga aur hidaayat-yaafta na reh sakoonga

Keh dijiye ke main Parwardigar ki taraf se khuli hui daleel rakhta hoon aur tum ne use jhutlaaya hai. To mere paas woh azaab nahin hai jis ki tumhein jaldi hai. Hukm sirf Allah ke ikhtiyaar mein hai, wahi haq ko bayaan karta hai aur wahi behtareen faisla karne waala hai
Keh dijiye ke agar mere ikhtiyaar mein woh azaab hota jis ki tumhein jaldi hai to ab tak hamaare tumhaare darmiyaan faisla ho chuka hota, aur Khuda zaalimeen ko khoob jaanta hai

Aur us ke paas ghaib ke khazaane hain jinhein us ke ilaawa koi nahin jaanta hai, aur woh khushk o tar sab ka jaanne waala hai. Koi patta bhi girta hai to use us ka ilm hai. Zameen ki taareekiyon mein koi daana ya koi khushk o tar aisa nahin hai jo kitaab-e-mubeen ke andar mahfooz na ho

Aur wahi Khuda hai jo tumhein raat mein goya ke ek tarah ki maut de deta hai, aur din mein tumhaare tamaam aamaal se baakhabar hai, aur phir din mein tumhein utha deta hai taake muqarrara muddat-e-hayaat poori ki ja sake. Us ke baad tum sab ki baazgasht usi ki baargaah mein hai, aur phir woh tumhein tumhaare aamaal ke baare mein baakhabar karega

Aur wahi Khuda hai jo apne bandon par ghaalib hai aur tum sab par muhaafiz farishte bhejta hai, yahaan tak ke jab kisi ki maut ka waqt aa jaata hai to hamaare bheje hue numaainde use utha lete hain aur kisi tarah ki kotaahi nahin karte
Phir sab apne Maula-e-barhaq Parwardigar ki taraf palta diye jaate hain. Aagaah ho jaao ke faisle ka haq sirf usi ko hai aur woh bahut jaldi hisaab karne waala hai

Un se kahiye ke khushki aur tari ki taareekiyon se kaun najaat deta hai jise tum gidgida kar aur khufiya tareeqe se aawaaz dete ho ke agar is museebat se najaat de dega to hum shukr-guzaar ban jaayenge
Keh dijiye ke Khuda hi tumhein un tamaam zulmaat se aur har karb o bechaini se najaat dene waala hai, us ke baad tum log shirk ikhtiyaar kar lete ho

Keh dijiye ke wahi is baat par bhi qaadir hai ke tumhaare oopar se ya pairon ke neeche se azaab bhej de, ya ek giroh ko doosre se takra de aur ek ke zariye doosre ko azaab ka maza chakha de. Dekho hum kis tarah aayaat ko palat palat kar bayaan karte hain ke shaayad un ki samajh mein aa jaaye
Aur aap ki qaum ne is Quran ki takzeeb ki haalaanke woh bilkul haq hai. To aap keh dijiye ke main tumhaara nigehbaan nahin hoon
Har khabar ke liye ek waqt muqarrar hai aur anqareeb tumhein maaloom ho jaaega

Aur jab tum dekho ke log hamaari nishaaniyon ke baare mein be-rabt behs kar rahe hain to un se kinaara-kash ho jaao yahaan tak ke woh doosri baat mein masroof ho jaayein, aur agar Shaitaan ghaafil kar de to yaad aane ke baad phir zaalimon ke saath na baithna
Aur saahibaan-e-taqwa par un ke hisaab ki koi zimmedaari nahin hai, lekin yeh ek yaad-dihaani hai ke shaayad yeh log bhi taqwa ikhtiyaar kar lein

Aur un logon ko chhod do jinhon ne apne deen ko khel tamaasha bana rakha hai aur inhein zindagaani-e-duniya ne dhoke mein mubtala kar diya hai, aur un ko yaad-dihaani karaate raho ke mabaada koi shakhs apne kiye ki bina par aise azaab mein mubtala ho jaaye ke Allah ke ilaawa koi sifaarish karne waala aur madad karne waala na ho, aur saare mu'aawaze ikattha bhi kar de to use qubool na kiya jaaye. Yahi woh log hain jinhein un ke kartoot ki bina par balaaon mein mubtala kiya gaya hai, ke ab un ke liye garam paani ka mashroob hai aur un ke kufr ki bina par dardnaak azaab hai

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke kya hum Khuda ko chhod kar un ko pukaarein jo na faaida pahuncha sakte hain aur na nuqsaan, aur is tarah Allah ke hidaayat dene ke baad ulte paaon palat jaayein, jis tarah ke kisi shakhs ko Shaitaan ne roo-e-zameen par behka diya ho aur woh hairaan o sargardaan maara maara phir raha ho, aur us ke kuch ashaab use hidaayat ki taraf pukaar rahe hon ke idhar aa jaao? Aap keh dijiye ke hidaayat sirf Allah ki hidaayat hai, aur humein hukm diya gaya hai ke hum Rabb-ul-Aalameen ki baargaah mein saraapa tasleem rahein
Aur dekho namaaz qaaim karo aur Allah se daro ke wahi woh hai jis ki baargaah mein haazir kiye jaaoge

Wahi woh hai jis ne aasmaan o zameen ko haq ke saath paida kiya hai, aur woh jab bhi kehta hai ke ho ja to woh cheez ho jaati hai. Us ka qaul barhaq hai, aur jis din soor phoonka jaaega us din saara ikhtiyaar usi ke haath mein hoga. Woh ghaaib aur haazir sab ka jaanne waala, saahib-e-hikmat aur har shai se baakhabar hai
Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Ibraheem ne apne murabbi baap Aazar se kaha ke kya tu in buton ko khuda banaaye hue hai? Main to tujhe aur teri qaum ko khuli hui gumraahi mein dekh raha hoon
Aur isi tarah hum Ibraheem ko aasmaan o zameen ke ikhtiyaaraat dikhlaate hain, aur is liye ke woh yaqeen karne waalon mein shaamil ho jaayein
Pas jab un par raat ki taareeki chhaayi aur unhon ne sitaare ko dekha to kaha ke kya yeh mera Rab hai? Phir jab woh ghuroob ho gaya to unhon ne kaha ke main doob jaane waalon ko dost nahin rakhta
Phir jab chaand ko chamakta dekha to kaha ke phir yeh Rab hoga? Phir jab woh bhi doob gaya to kaha ke agar Parwardigar hi hidaayat na dega to main gumraahon mein ho jaaoonga
Phir jab chamakte hue sooraj ko dekha to kaha ke phir yeh khuda hoga ke yeh ziyaada bada hai? Lekin jab woh bhi ghuroob ho gaya to kaha ke ae qaum! Main tumhaare shirk se bari aur bezaar hoon
Mera rukh tamaam-tar us Khuda ki taraf hai jis ne aasmaanon aur zameen ko paida kiya hai, aur main baatil se kinaara-kash hoon aur mushrikon mein se nahin hoon

Aur jab un ki qaum ne un se kat-hujjati ki to kaha ke kya mujh se Khuda ke baare mein behs kar rahe ho jis ne mujhe hidaayat de di hai? Aur main tumhaare shareek-karda khudaaon se bilkul nahin darta hoon, magar yeh ke khud mera Khuda koi baat chaahe, ke us ka ilm har shai se wasee'-tar hai. Kya yeh baat tumhaari samajh mein nahin aati hai

Aur main kis tarah tumhaare khudaaon se dar sakta hoon jab ke tum is baat se nahin darte ho ke tum ne un ko Khuda ka shareek bana diya hai jis ke baare mein Khuda ki taraf se koi daleel nahin naazil hui hai? To ab donon fareeqon mein kaun ziyaada amn o sukoon ka haqdaar hai, agar tum jaanne waale ho to batao
Jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne apne imaan ko zulm se aaloodah nahin kiya unhi ke liye amn o sukoon hai aur wahi hidaayat-yaafta hain

Yeh hamaari daleel hai jise hum ne Ibraheem ko un ki qaum ke muqaable mein ata ki, aur hum jis ko chaahte hain us ke darajaat ko buland kar dete hain. Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai aur baakhabar bhi hai

Aur hum ne Ibraheem ko Is'haaq o Ya'qoob diye aur sab ko hidaayat bhi di, aur us se pehle Nooh ko hidaayat di, aur phir Ibraheem ki aulaad mein Daawood, Sulaimaan, Ayyoob, Yusuf, Moosa aur Haaroon qaraar diye, aur hum isi tarah nek amal karne waalon ko jaza dete hain
Aur Zakariya, Yahya, Eesa aur Ilyaas ko bhi rakha jo sab ke sab nek-kirdaaron mein the
Aur Ismaaeel, Al-Yasa', Yunus aur Loot bhi banaaye aur sab ko aalameen se afzal o behtar banaaya
Aur phir un ke baap daada, aulaad aur biraadari mein se aur khud inhein bhi muntakhab kiya aur sab ko seedhe raaste ki hidaayat kar di
Yahi Khuda ki hidaayat hai jise jis bande ko chaahta hai ata kar deta hai, aur agar yeh log shirk ikhtiyaar kar lete to un ke bhi saare aamaal barbaad ho jaate

Yahi woh afraad hain jinhein hum ne kitaab, hukoomat aur nubuwwat ata ki hai. Ab agar yeh log in baaton ka bhi inkaar karte hain to hum ne in baaton ka zimmedaar ek aisi qaum ko banaaya hai jo inkaar karne waali nahin hai

Yahi woh log hain jinhein Allah ne hidaayat di hai, lihaaza aap bhi isi hidaayat ke raaste par chalein, aur keh dijiye ke hum tum se is kaar-e-tableegh o hidaayat ka koi ajr nahin chaahte hain. Yeh Quran to aalameen ki yaad-dihaani ka zariya hai

Aur un logon ne waaqe'i Khuda ki qadr nahin ki jab ke yeh keh diya ke Allah ne kisi bashar par kuch nahin naazil kiya hai. To un se poochhiye ke yeh kitaab jo Moosa le kar aaye the, jo noor aur logon ke liye hidaayat thi, aur jise tum ne chand kaaghazaat bana diya hai, aur kuch hissa zaahir kiya aur kuch chhupa diya, haalaanke us ke zariye tumhein woh sab bata diya gaya tha jo tumhaare baap daada ko bhi nahin maaloom tha, yeh sab kis ne naazil kiya hai? Ab aap keh dijiye ke woh wahi Allah hai, aur phir inhein chhod dijiye, yeh apni bakwaas mein khelte phirein

Aur yeh kitaab jo hum ne naazil ki hai yeh ba-barkat hai aur apne pehle waali kitaabon ki tasdeeq karne waali hai, aur yeh is liye hai ke aap Makka aur us ke atraaf waalon ko daraayein. Aur jo log aakhirat par imaan rakhte hain woh is par imaan rakhte hain aur apni namaaz ki paabandi karte hain

Aur us se bada zaalim kaun hoga jo Khuda par jhoota ilzaam lagaaye ya us ke naazil kiye baghair yeh keh de ke mujh par wahi naazil hui hai, aur jo yeh keh de ke main bhi Khuda ki tarah baatein naazil kar sakta hoon. Aur agar aap dekhte ke zaalim maut ki sakhtiyon mein hain aur malaaika apne haath badhaaye hue aawaaz de rahe hain ke ab apni jaan nikaal do, ke aaj tumhein tumhaare jhoote bayaanaat aur ilzaamaat par ruswaai ka azaab diya jaaega, ke tum aayaat-e-Khuda se inkaar aur istikbaar kar rahe the

Aur bil-aakhir tum isi tarah hamaare paas tanha aaye jis tarah hum ne tum ko paida kiya tha, aur jo kuch tumhein diya tha sab apne peechhe chhod aaye, aur hum tumhaare saath tumhaare un sifaarish karne waalon ko bhi nahin dekhte jinhein tum ne apne liye Khuda ka shareek banaaya tha. Tumhaare un ke ta'alluqaat qat'a ho gaye aur tumhaara khayaal tum se ghaaib ho gaya
Khuda hi woh hai jo guthli aur daane ka shigaafta karne waala hai. Woh murda se zinda aur zinda se murda ko nikaalta hai. Yahi tumhaara Khuda hai, to tum kidhar behke ja rahe ho
Woh noor-e-sahar ka shigaafta karne waala hai, aur us ne raat ko wajh-e-sukoon aur shams o qamar ko zariya-e-hisaab banaaya hai. Yeh us saahib-e-izzat o hikmat ki muqarrar-karda taqdeer hai

Wahi woh hai jis ne tumhaare liye sitaare muqarrar kiye hain ke un ke zariye khushki aur tari ki taareekiyon mein raasta maaloom kar sako. Hum ne tamaam nishaaniyon ko us qaum ke liye tafseel ke saath bayaan kiya hai jo jaanne waali hai

Wahi woh hai jis ne tum sab ko ek nafs se paida kiya hai, phir sab ke liye qaraar-gaah aur manzil-e-wadee'at muqarrar ki hai. Hum ne saahibaan-e-fahm ke liye tamaam nishaaniyon ko tafseel ke saath bayaan kar diya hai

Wahi Khuda woh hai jis ne aasmaan se paani naazil kiya hai, phir hum ne har shai ke koye nikaale, phir hari bhari shaakhein nikaalin jin se hum gutthe hue daane nikaalte hain, aur khajoor ke shagoofe se latakte hue guchchhe paida kiye, aur angoor o zaitoon aur anaar ke baaghaat paida kiye jo shakl mein milte julte aur maze mein bilkul alag alag hain. Zara us ke phal aur us ke pakne ki taraf ghaur se dekho ke is mein saahibaan-e-imaan ke liye kitni nishaaniyaan paayi jaati hain

Aur un logon ne jinnaat ko Khuda ka shareek bana diya hai haalaanke Khuda ne inhein paida kiya hai, phir us ke liye baghair jaane boojhe bete aur betiyaan bhi taiyaar kar di hain, jab ke woh be-niyaaz aur un ke bayaan-karda ausaaf se kaheen ziyaada buland o baala hai
Woh zameen o aasmaan ka eejaad karne waala hai. Us ke aulaad kis tarah ho sakti hai, us ki to koi biwi bhi nahin hai, aur woh har shai ka khaaliq hai aur har cheez ka jaanne waala hai
Wahi Allah tumhaara Parwardigar hai jis ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin. Woh har shai ka khaaliq hai, usi ki ibaadat karo, wahi har shai ka nigehbaan hai
Nigaahein use pa nahin saktin aur woh nigaahon ka baraabar idraak rakhta hai, ke woh Lateef bhi hai aur Khabeer bhi hai

Tumhaare paas tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se dalaail aa chuke hain. Ab jo baseerat se kaam lega woh apne liye, aur jo andha ban jaaega woh bhi apna hi nuqsaan karega, aur main tum logon ka nigehbaan nahin hoon
Aur isi tarah hum palat palat kar aayatein pesh karte hain, aur taake woh yeh kahein ke aap ne Quran padh liya hai, aur hum jaanne waalon ke liye Quran ko waazeh kar dein
Aap apni taraf aane waali wahi-e-Ilaahi ka ittibaa' karein ke us ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai, aur mushrikeen se kinaara-kashi kar lein
Aur agar Khuda chaahta to yeh shirk hi na kar sakte, aur hum ne aap ko un ka nigehbaan nahin banaaya hai aur na aap un ke zimmedaar hain

Aur khabardaar tum log inhein bura bhala na kaho jin ko yeh log Khuda ko chhod kar pukaarte hain, ke is tarah yeh dushmani mein baghair samjhe boojhe Khuda ko bura bhala kahenge. Hum ne isi tarah har qaum ke liye us ke amal ko aaraasta kar diya hai, us ke baad sab ki baazgasht Parwardigar hi ki baargaah mein hai aur wahi sab ko un ke aamaal ke baare mein baakhabar karega

Aur un logon ne Allah ki sakht qasmein khaayin ke un ki marzi ki nishaani aayi to zaroor imaan le aayenge. To aap keh dijiye ke nishaaniyaan to sab Khuda hi ke paas hain, aur tum log kya jaano ke woh aa bhi jaayengi to yeh log imaan na laayenge
Aur hum un ke qalb o nazar ko is tarah palat denge jis tarah yeh pehle imaan nahin laaye the, aur un ko gumraahi mein thokar khaane ke liye chhod denge

Aur agar hum un ki taraf malaaika naazil bhi kar dein aur un se murde kalaam bhi kar lein aur un ke saamne tamaam cheezon ko jama bhi kar dein to bhi yeh imaan na laayenge, magar yeh ke Khuda hi chaah le, lekin un ki aksariyat jahaalat hi se kaam leti hai

Aur isi tarah hum ne har nabi ke liye jinnaat o insaan ke shayaateen ko un ka dushman qaraar de diya hai. Yeh aapas mein ek doosre ki taraf dhoka dene ke liye muhmal baaton ke ishaare karte hain, aur agar Khuda chaah leta to yeh aisa na kar sakte, lihaaza ab aap inhein un ke iftira ke haal par chhod dein

Aur yeh is liye karte hain ke jin logon ka imaan aakhirat par nahin hai un ke dil un ki taraf maail ho jaayein aur woh ise pasand kar lein, aur phir khud bhi unhi ki tarah iftira-pardaazi karne lagein

Kya main Khuda ke ilaawa koi hakam talaash karoon jab ke wahi woh hai jis ne tumhaari taraf mufassal kitaab naazil ki hai? Aur jin logon ko hum ne kitaab di hai inhein maaloom hai ke yeh Quran un ke Parwardigar ki taraf se haq ke saath naazil hua hai, lihaaza hargiz aap shak karne waalon mein shaamil na hon
Aur aap ke Rab ka kalima, Quran, sadaaqat aur adaalat ke e'tebaar se bilkul mukammal hai, us ka koi tabdeel karne waala nahin hai, aur woh sunne waala bhi hai aur jaanne waala bhi hai
Aur agar aap roo-e-zameen ki aksariyat ka ittibaa' kar lenge to yeh raah-e-Khuda se behka denge. Yeh sirf gumaan ka ittibaa' karte hain aur sirf andaazon se kaam lete hain
Aap ke Parwardigar ko khoob maaloom hai ke kaun us ke raaste se behakne waala hai aur kaun hidaayat haasil karne waala hai
Lihaaza tum log sirf us jaanwar ka gosht khaao jis par Khuda ka naam liya gaya ho, agar tumhaara imaan us ki aayaton par hai

Aur tumhein kya ho gaya hai ke tum woh nahin khaate ho jis par naam-e-Khuda liya gaya hai, jab ke us ne jin cheezon ko haraam kiya hai inhein tafseel se bayaan kar diya hai, magar yeh ke tum majboor ho jaao to aur baat hai. Aur bahut se log to apni khwaahishaat ki bina par logon ko baghair jaane boojhe gumraah karte hain, aur tumhaara Parwardigar un ziyaadati karne waalon ko khoob jaanta hai
Aur tum log zaahiri aur baatini tamaam gunaahon ko chhod do, ke jo log gunaah ka irtikaab karte hain anqareeb inhein un ke aamaal ka badla diya jaaega

Aur dekho jis par naam-e-Khuda na liya gaya ho use na khaana ke yeh fisq hai, aur shayaateen to apne waalon ki taraf khufiya ishaare karte hi rehte hain taake yeh log tum se jhagda karein, aur agar tum logon ne un ki itaa'at kar li to tumhaara shumaar bhi mushrikeen mein ho jaaega

Kya jo shakhs murda tha phir hum ne use zinda kiya aur us ke liye ek noor qaraar diya jis ke sahaare woh logon ke darmiyaan chalta hai, us ki misaal us ke jaisi ho sakti hai jo taareekiyon mein ho aur un se nikal bhi na sakta ho? Isi tarah kuffaar ke liye un ke aamaal ko aaraasta kar diya gaya hai

Aur isi tarah hum ne har qarye mein bade bade mujrimeen ko mauqa diya hai ke woh makkaari karein, aur un ki makkaari ka asar khud un ke ilaawa kisi par nahin hota hai, lekin inhein is ka bhi sha'oor nahin hai

Aur jab un ke paas koi nishaani aati hai to kehte hain ke hum us waqt tak imaan na laayenge jab tak humein bhi waisi hi wahi na di jaaye jaisi rasoolon ko di gayi hai, jab ke Allah behtar jaanta hai ke apni risaalat ko kahaan rakhega, aur anqareeb mujrimeen ko un ke jurm ki paadaash mein Khuda ke yahaan zillat aur shadeed-tareen azaab ka saamna karna hoga

Pas Khuda jise hidaayat dena chaahta hai us ke seene ko Islam ke liye kushaada kar deta hai, aur jis ko gumraahi mein chhodna chaahta hai us ke seene ko aisa tang aur dushwaar-guzaar bana deta hai jaise aasmaan ki taraf buland ho raha ho. Woh isi tarah be-imaanon par un ki kasaafat ko musallat kar deta hai
Aur yahi tumhaare Parwardigar ka seedha raasta hai. Hum ne naseehat haasil karne waalon ke liye aayaat ko mufassal taur se bayaan kar diya hai
Un logon ke liye Parwardigar ke nazdeek Daar-us-Salaam hai, aur woh un ke aamaal ki bina par un ka sarparast hai

Aur jis din woh sab ko mahshoor karega to kahega ke ae giroh-e-jinnaat! Tum ne to apne ko insaanon se ziyaada bana liya tha. Aur insaanon mein un ke dost kahenge ke Parwardigar! Hum mein sab ne ek doosre se faaida uthaaya hai aur ab hum us muddat ko pahunch gaye hain jo tu ne hamaari mohlat ke waaste mu'ayyan ki thi. Irshaad hoga to ab tumhaara thikaana Jahannam hai jahaan hamesha hamesha rehna hai, magar yeh ke Khuda hi aazaadi chaah le. Beshak tumhaara Parwardigar saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai aur jaanne waala bhi hai
Aur isi tarah hum ba'z zaalimon ko un ke aamaal ki bina par ba'z par musallat kar dete hain

Ae giroh-e-jinn o ins! Kya tumhaare paas tum mein se rasool nahin aaye jo hamaari aayaton ko bayaan karte aur tumhein aaj ke din ki mulaaqaat se daraate? Woh kahenge ke hum khud apne khilaaf gawaah hain. Aur un ko zindagaani-e-duniya ne dhoke mein daal rakha tha, unhon ne khud apne khilaaf gawaahi di ke woh kaafir the
Yeh is liye ke tumhaara Parwardigar kisi bhi qarye ko zulm o ziyaadati se is tarah tabaah o barbaad nahin karna chaahta ke us ke rehne waale bilkul ghaafil aur bekhabar hon
Aur har ek ke liye us ke aamaal ke mutaabiq darajaat hain, aur tumhaara Parwardigar un ke aamaal se ghaafil nahin hai

Aur aap ka Parwardigar be-niyaaz aur saahib-e-rehmat hai. Woh chaahe to tum sab ko duniya se utha le aur tumhaari jagah par jis qaum ko chaahe le aaye, jis tarah tum ko doosri qaum ki aulaad mein rakha hai
Yaqeenan jo tum se wa'da kiya gaya hai woh saamne aane waala hai, aur tum Khuda ko aajiz banaane waale nahin ho

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke tum bhi apni jagah par amal karo aur main bhi kar raha hoon. Anqareeb tum ko maaloom ho jaaega ke anjaam-e-kaar kis ke haq mein behtar hai. Beshak zaalim kaamyaab hone waale nahin hain

Aur un logon ne Khuda ki paida ki hui kheti mein aur jaanwaron mein us ka hissa bhi lagaaya hai, aur yeh e'laan kiya hai ke yeh un ke khayaal ke mutaabiq Khuda ke liye hai aur yeh hamaare shareekon ke liye hai. Us ke baad jo shurakaa ka hissa hai woh Khuda tak nahin ja sakta hai, aur jo Khuda ka hissa hai woh un ke shareekon tak pahunch sakta hai. Kis qadr badtareen faisla hai jo yeh log kar rahe hain

Aur isi tarah un shareekon ne bahut se mushrikeen ke liye aulaad ke qatl ko bhi aaraasta kar diya hai taake un ko tabaah o barbaad kar dein aur un par deen ko mushtabah kar dein, haalaanke Khuda is ke khilaaf chaah leta to yeh kuch nahin kar sakte the. Lihaaza aap un ko un ki iftira-pardaaziyon par chhod dein aur pareshaan na hon

Aur yeh log kehte hain ke yeh jaanwar aur kheti achhooti hai, ise un ke khayaalaat ke mutaabiq wahi kha sakte hain jin ke baare mein woh chaahenge, aur kuch chaupaaye hain jin ki peeth haraam hai, aur kuch chaupaaye jin ko zibah karte waqt naam-e-Khuda bhi nahin liya gaya, aur sab ki nisbat Khuda ki taraf de rakhi hai. Anqareeb un tamaam bohtaanon ka badla inhein diya jaaega

Aur kehte hain ke un chaupaayon ke pet mein jo bachche hain woh sirf hamaare mardon ke liye hain aur auraton par haraam hain. Haan agar murdaar hon to sab shareek honge. Anqareeb Khuda un bayaanaat ka badla dega ke woh saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai aur sab ka jaanne waala bhi hai

Yaqeenan woh log khasaare mein hain jinhon ne hamaaqat mein baghair jaane boojhe apni aulaad ko qatl kar diya, aur jo rizq Khuda ne inhein diya hai use usi par bohtaan laga kar apne oopar haraam kar liya. Yeh sab behak gaye hain aur hidaayat-yaafta nahin hain

Woh Khuda woh hai jis ne takhton par chadhaaye hue bhi aur us ke khilaaf bhi har tarah ke baaghaat paida kiye hain, aur khajoor aur zara'at paida ki hai jis ke maze mukhtalif hain, aur zaitoon aur anaar bhi paida kiye hain jin mein ba'z aapas mein ek doosre se milte julte hain aur ba'z mukhtalif hain. Tum sab un ke phalon ko jab woh taiyaar ho jaayein to khaao, aur jab kaatne ka din aaye to un ka haq ada kar do, aur khabardaar israaf na karna ke Khuda israaf karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhta hai

Aur chaupaayon mein ba'z bojh uthaane waale aur ba'z zameen se lag kar chalne waale hain. Tum sab Khuda ke diye hue rizq ko khaao aur Shaitaani qadmon ki pairavi na karo ke Shaitaan tumhaara khula hua dushman hai

Aath qism ke jode hain, bhed ke do aur bakri ke do. Un se kahiye Khuda ne un donon ke nar haraam kiye hain ya maada, ya woh bachche jo un ki maada ke pet mein paaye jaate hain? Zara tum log is baare mein humein bhi khabar do agar apne da'we mein sachche ho

Aur oont mein se do aur gaaye mein se do. Un se kahiye ke Khuda ne naron ko haraam qaraar diya hai ya maadinon ko, ya un ko jo maadinon ke shikam mein hain? Kya tum log us waqt haazir the jab Khuda un ko haraam karne ki wasiyyat kar raha tha? Phir us se bada zaalim kaun hai jo Khuda par jhoota ilzaam lagaaye taake logon ko baghair jaane boojhe gumraah kare? Yaqeenan Allah zaalim qaum ko hidaayat nahin deta hai

Aap keh dijiye ke main apni taraf aane waali wahi mein kisi bhi khaane waale ke liye koi haraam nahin paata, magar yeh ke murdaar ho ya bahaaya hua khoon ya soor ka gosht ho, ke yeh sab najis aur gandagi hai, ya woh fisq ho jise ghair-e-Khuda ke naam par zibah kiya gaya ho. Us ke baad bhi koi majboor ho jaaye aur na sarkash ho na had se tajaawuz karne waala, to Parwardigar bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Aur Yahoodiyon par hum ne har naakhun waale jaanwar ko haraam kar diya, aur gaaye aur bhed ki charbi ko haraam kar diya, magar jo charbi ke peeth par ho ya aanton par ho ya jo haddiyon se lagi hui ho. Yeh hum ne un ko un ki baghaawat aur sarkashi ki saza di hai, aur hum bilkul sachche hain
Phir agar yeh log aap ko jhutlaayein to keh dijiye ke tumhaara Parwardigar badi wasee' rehmat waala hai, lekin us ka azaab mujrimeen se taala bhi nahin ja sakta hai

Anqareeb yeh mushrikeen kahenge ke agar Khuda chaahta to na hum mushrik hote na hamaare baap daada, aur na hum kisi cheez ko haraam qaraar dete. Isi tarah un se pehle waalon ne rasoolon ki takzeeb ki thi yahaan tak ke hamaare azaab ka maza chakh liya. Un se keh dijiye ke tumhaare paas koi daleel hai to humein bhi batao. Tum to sirf khayaalaat ka ittibaa' karte ho aur andaazon ki baatein karte ho
Keh dijiye ke Allah ke paas manzil tak pahunchaane waali daleelein hain, woh agar chaahta to jabran tum sab ko hidaayat de deta

Keh dijiye ke zara apne gawaahon ko to laao jo gawaahi dete hain ke Khuda ne is cheez ko haraam qaraar diya hai. Us ke baad woh gawaahi bhi de dein to aap un ke saath gawaahi na dijiyega, aur un logon ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na kijiyega jinhon ne hamaari aayaton ko jhutlaaya hai aur woh aakhirat par imaan nahin rakhte hain aur apne Parwardigar ka hamsar qaraar dete hain

Keh dijiye ke aao hum tumhein bataayein ke tumhaare Parwardigar ne kya kya haraam kiya hai: Khabardaar kisi ko us ka shareek na banaana, aur maa baap ke saath achchha bartaao karna, apni aulaad ko ghurbat ki bina par qatl na karna ke hum tumhein bhi rizq de rahe hain aur inhein bhi, aur badkaariyon ke qareeb na jaana woh zaahiri hon ya chhupi hui, aur kisi aise nafs ko jise Khuda ne haraam kar diya hai qatl na karna magar yeh ke tumhaara koi haq ho. Yeh woh baatein hain jin ki Khuda ne naseehat ki hai taake tumhein aql aa jaaye

Aur khabardaar maal-e-yateem ke qareeb bhi na jaana magar us tareeqe se jo behtareen tareeqa ho, yahaan tak ke woh tawaanaai ki umr tak pahunch jaayein, aur naap tol mein insaaf se poora poora dena. Hum kisi nafs ko us ki wus'at se ziyaada takleef nahin dete hain. Aur jab baat karo to insaaf ke saath, chaahe apne aqrabaa hi ke khilaaf kyon na ho, aur ahd-e-Khuda ko poora karo ke us ki Parwardigar ne tumhein wasiyyat ki hai ke shaayad tum ibrat haasil kar sako

Aur yeh hamaara seedha raasta hai, is ka ittibaa' karo aur doosre raaston ke peechhe na jaao ke raah-e-Khuda se alag ho jaaoge. Isi ki Parwardigar ne hidaayat di hai ke is tarah shaayad muttaqi aur parhezgaar ban jaao

Us ke baad hum ne Moosa ko achchhi baaton ki takmeel karne waali kitaab di, aur us mein har shai ko tafseel se bayaan kar diya, aur use hidaayat aur rehmat qaraar de diya ke shaayad yeh log liqaa-e-Ilaahi par imaan le aayein
Aur yeh kitaab jo hum ne naazil ki hai yeh badi ba-barkat hai, lihaaza is ka ittibaa' karo aur taqwa ikhtiyaar karo ke shaayad tum par reham kiya jaaye
Yeh na kehne lago ke kitaab-e-Khuda to hum se pehle do jamaa'aton par naazil hui thi aur hum us ke padhne padhaane se bekhabar the

Ya yeh kaho ke hamaare oopar bhi kitaab naazil hoti to hum un se ziyaada hidaayat-yaafta hote. To ab tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf se waazeh daleel aur hidaayat o rehmat aa chuki hai. Phir us ke baad us se bada zaalim kaun hoga jo Allah ki nishaaniyon ko jhutlaaye aur un se e'raaz kare? Anqareeb hum apni nishaaniyon se e'raaz karne waalon par badtareen azaab karenge, aur woh hamaari aayaton se e'raaz karne waale aur rokne waale hain

Yeh sirf is baat ke muntazir hain ke un ke paas malaaika aa jaayein ya khud Parwardigar aa jaaye ya us ki ba'z nishaaniyaan aa jaayein. To jis din us ki ba'z nishaaniyaan aa jaayengi us din jo nafs pehle se imaan nahin laaya hai, ya us ne imaan laane ke baad koi bhalaai nahin ki hai, us ke imaan ka koi faaida na hoga. To ab keh dijiye ke tum log bhi intizaar karo aur main bhi intizaar kar raha hoon

Jin logon ne apne deen mein tafriqa paida kiya aur tukde tukde ho gaye un se aap ka koi ta'alluq nahin hai. Un ka mu'aamala Khuda ke hawaale hai, phir woh inhein un ke aamaal ke baare mein baakhabar karega
Jo shakhs bhi neki karega use das guna ajr milega, aur jo buraai karega use sirf utni hi saza milegi, aur koi zulm na kiya jaaega

Aap keh dijiye ke mere Parwardigar ne mujhe seedhe raaste ki hidaayat de di hai, jo ek mazboot deen aur baatil se e'raaz karne waale Ibraheem ka mazhab hai, aur woh mushrikeen mein se hargiz nahin the
Keh dijiye ke meri namaaz, meri ibaadatein, meri zindagi, meri maut sab Allah ke liye hai jo aalameen ka paalne waala hai
Us ka koi shareek nahin hai, aur isi ka mujhe hukm diya gaya hai, aur main sab se pehla Musalmaan hoon

Keh dijiye ke kya main Khuda ke ilaawa koi aur Rab talaash karoon jab ke wahi har shai ka paalne waala hai? Aur jo nafs jo kuch karega us ka wabaal usi ke zimme hoga, aur koi nafs doosre ka bojh na uthaaega. Us ke baad tum sab ki baazgasht tumhaare Parwardigar ki taraf hai, phir woh bataaega ke tum kis cheez mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe the

Wahi woh Khuda hai jis ne tum ko zameen mein naaib banaaya aur ba'z ke darajaat ko ba'z se buland kiya taake tumhein apne diye hue se aazmaaye. Tumhaara Parwardigar bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai, aur woh beshak bahut bakhshne waala meharbaan hai
